sourceBudgets._paymentDeskClientMaxLinesNote: Lowered 3520 -> 3516 on 2026-08-21: exactly what the file costs, zero headroom, so the next line added fails CI. The five-component split scoped in docs/design/design-system.md 5.1 is still the fix and is still not done. That needs its own change, verified by posting real payments in TEST-2026-27 — not the tail of a thousand-file move where the risky part would be indistinguishable from the safe part in review. Extracting useHaptics into hooks/ recovered only ~8 lines; the useOnlineStatus half was never wired up and was deleted (ConnectionPill already carried that behaviour). Do NOT raise this — split a component out instead.
